correctness.rationale: The grounded quadratic form is positive definite on the entire compact positive-budget simplex. The second variation is 2||A^(-1/2) H A^(-1)||_F^2, positive for every nonzero diagonal direction; thus the unrestricted optimum is unique and invariant under permutations within each part. Splitting into the two zero-sum spaces and the two part-constant vectors gives the stated scalar inverse trace. Independent exact differentiation recovers both endpoint expressions: the derivative into the feasible segment at y=0 is negative for all q>=3, and the derivative into the segment at x=0 has the boxed numerator. Strict convexity makes a nonnegative derivative at x=0 sufficient, including equality, and otherwise gives one interior critical point. The unfolded level function (t+2)^3/t has its unique minimum 27 at t=1 and tends to infinity at both ends; integer q(q-1) crosses 27 first at q=6. On the two monotone branches the roots tend respectively to zero and infinity, giving q t_-~8/q and q t_+~q^2 from the defining equation. The independent full-matrix directional derivative at q=6, B=6 equals 1/54. The frozen self-review's phrase 'peripheral-only boundary is never optimal' in its correctness paragraph reverses the boundary label; RESULT.md correctly rules out y=0, the hubs-only boundary.
residual_risks: The onset is minimal only within the specified two-hub complete bipartite family; the computation is supplementary and is not proof-assistant certification.

value.rationale: For a standard variance objective on a natural redundant-hub family, the unique allocation is not nested in budget. Exact onset and thresholds predict when two simultaneously active actuators should both be disabled, and separate a vanishing lower budget from a diverging upper one. This extends rather than rediscovers the star phenomenon, with a new two-hub test that avoids solving the interior optimization to decide support.
residual_risks: No implication for arbitrary K_{p,q}, heterogeneous prices, capped gains or a spectral-gap objective.
